lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: And Caelan? Eat something before you go.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Half a slice of bread is not a meal.

lines.speaker: serene
lines.text: Sit and eat. There'll be plenty to do before the festival.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: One more adjustment. Then I really am getting back to the preparations.

lines.speaker: caelan
lines.text: Should I tell Mother Serene that?

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Tell her the preparations are progressing. That covers both things.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Look! The wheel turns the little crank. Mostly. It catches if I rush it.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: Already carried one over. I can help and have a good idea in the same morning.

lines.speaker: tomas
lines.text: I wonder what Mira would change. She would spot it straight away.

note: Serene breakfast dialogue and proposed ambient Tomas dialogue; no quest starts. Flags persist for the running session.
